name: Can I repair a bathtub faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a bathtub faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor faucet repairs, such as replacing a simple washer, might seem DIY-friendly, more complex issues often require specialized tools and expertise. Attempting a repair without proper knowledge can lead to further damage, water leaks, or issues with water pressure. Hiring a professional ensures the repair is done correctly, preventing future problems and complying with local plumbing codes. CG Plumbing Solutions recommends professional service for anything beyond a simple washer replacement to avoid potential complications and ensure lasting results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple faucet repairs might be DIY, but complex issues require professional expertise to prevent further damage and ensure proper function.
